svg.title: Keeper — eight embedded WebP layers
svg.desc: Seven tentacles and one body, individually cropped and embedded as lossless WebP images with alpha. Source positions are scaled from 2000 to 2048 pixels. The keeper group moves the entire character; tentacle-1 through tentacle-7 and body control each part. No animation is applied. Eye glow is contained within the body silhouette to match the supplied reference.
